needed.evidence: The sidewalk under 1m on the right side is obstructed and appears uneventful for safe pedestrian movement.
needed.suggestion: Install a properly spaced sidewalk at least 1m wide along the right side of the roadway to ensure safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Informal parking of scooters and motorcycles is obstructing the footway.
needed.suggestion: Provide and enforce designated parking areas for scooters and motorcycles away from the footway to ensure it remains clear.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections and debris on the restricted footway could be a trip hazard.
needed.suggestion: Repave and level uneven sections of the footway on the right side to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There is no pedestrian crossing on the busy road despite high crossing demand.
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing with a central refuge to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians in this high-demand location.
